name: hit-the-ground-running
description: Hit The Ground Running: pushes the plan's 5-hour and weekly usage to the model, closes the agent-pool gate (no new subagents) near a limit but not on usage credits, pauses running sessions at 90% of the 5-hour limit, and resumes the session after a cap resets, compacting first when the context is large.

fiveHourResume.title: 5-hour cap resume
fiveHourResume.description: native: Claude's own auto-continue resumes 5-hour caps and the mod only compacts before it. mod: the mod resumes 5-hour caps itself; turn the native auto-continue off to avoid a double resume.

autoPause.title: Auto-pause at 5-hour usage
autoPause.description: When the 5-hour usage reaches this percentage, each session with a running turn does what /htgr-pause does: stops the turn and resumes after the 5-hour reset. Once per session per 5-hour period; off disables it.

weeklyResume.title: Weekly cap resume
weeklyResume.description: on: the mod resumes the session after a weekly cap resets. off: it does not.
